mapper.update: INSERT INTO finance (merge_key, accounting_standards, fiscal_year_cover_page) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{accountingStandards}, #{fiscalYearCoverPage}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO UPDATE SET accounting_standards = EXCLUDED.accounting_standards, fiscal_year_cover_page = EXCLUDED.fiscal_year_cover_page WHERE ( finance.accounting_standards, finance.fiscal_year_cover_page ) IS DISTINCT FROM ( EXCLUDED.accounting_standards, EXCLUDED.fiscal_year_cover_page )

INSERT INTO company_finance (company_id, finance_id, inserted_at, deleted) SELECT c.company_id, f.finance_id, now(), false FROM company c JOIN finance f ON f.merge_key = #{mergeKey} WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} ON CONFLICT (company_id, finance_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now() WHERE company_finance.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM false
UPDATE company_finance cf SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE cf.deleted = false AND cf.company_id = ( SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} )
